name: Nostalgic Recoil
source:
Nostalgi Recoil is Visual Novel made for a game jam [url=https://itch.io/jam/lumina-solus](Lumina Solus)[/url] about a weird and universal law.

Lucas returned 6 years in the past, back to his senior year in high school.
He's curious about what happened, but also want to enjoy this period in life once more, since the adult life has destroyed all of his dreams.
Then, a classmate is murdered.
